{
  "name": "ai-werewolf-arena",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "AI multi-agent Werewolf game arena, replay studio, and video generator",
  "packageManager": "bun@1.4.2",
  "workspaces": [
    "backend",
    "frontend",
    "packages/*"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev:frontend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-frontend dev",
    "replay:dev": "bun run --cwd frontend replay:dev",
    "build:backend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-backend build",
    "build:frontend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-frontend build",
    "check:backend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-backend check",
    "check:frontend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-frontend typecheck",
    "test": "bun run test:tooling && bun run test:packages && bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend",
    "test:backend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-backend test",
    "test:frontend": "bun --filter ai-werewolf-arena-frontend test",
    "check": "bun run lint:architecture && bun run check:fixtures && bun run check:tooling && bun run check:packages && bun run check:backend && bun run check:frontend",
    "lint:backend": "bun run --cwd backend lint:deps && bun run --cwd backend lint:boundaries && bun run --cwd backend lint:i18n",
    "lint:frontend": "bun run --cwd frontend lint",
    "lint": "bun run lint:architecture && bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:frontend",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "format:check": "prettier --check .",
    "check:tooling": "./backend/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tooling/tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "test:tooling": "bun --no-env-file test tooling/refactor",
    "check:packages": "bun --filter '@ai-werewolf-arena/*' check",
    "test:packages": "bun --filter '@ai-werewolf-arena/*' test",
    "lint:architecture": "bun --no-env-file tooling/refactor/architecture/run.ts check",
    "check:fixtures": "bun --no-env-file tooling/refactor/fixture-manifest.ts --check"
  },
  "engines": {
    "bun": ">=1.4.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "prettier": "3.9.9"
  }
}
